title: Manufacturing Excellence Lead
description:
Job Characteristics: This role will focus on leading program deployment, adoption, governance, and scale\-up of a global Manufacturing Excellence Platform and Digital Manufacturing Cell. The role will enable best\-in\-class manufacturing operations through Digital \& AI, manufacturing KPI control tower capabilities, paperless shop\-floor execution, and scalable loss\-elimination solutions. The Program Deployment Lead will partner with Manufacturing, TPM, HPN, Digital, AI, Engineering, Quality, Safety, Finance, and site leadership teams to convert the manufacturing digital vision into coordinated pilots, deployment waves, sustainment routines, and measurable business outcomes across Ecolab plants globally.


Education / Work Experience: Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing Operations, Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or related field of study. 8\+ years of relevant experience in manufacturing, supply chain, operational excellence, digital transformation, analytics, or technology\-enabled process improvement.


Independence Level / Reports to: Requires limited supervisory support from leader. Interfaces directly with global and regional manufacturing leaders, plant manager, Digital \& AI teams, TPM / HPN partners, Finance, Quality, Safety, Engineering, technology development resources, and deployment teams. Normally reports to Manufacturing Excellence / Digital Manufacturing program leadership or Planning / Operations leadership, depending on final organization design.


Our Global Supply Chain is a network of more than 100 manufacturing plants, distribution centers and other facilities designed and located to support our direct sales, marketing and distribution activities. We enable company growth by delivering savings through more efficient operations and high levels of service that create competitive advantage while earning and keeping customers' trust.


We are seeking a Program Deployment Lead – Manufacturing Excellence Platform / Digital Manufacturing Cell to lead the deployment of the Manufacturing Cell program from pilot through global scale\-up. The role will coordinate implementation of the manufacturing KPI control tower, paperless factory workstream, EKODE and related digital tools, and AI\-enabled loss\-elimination applications. The Program Deployment Lead will manage stakeholder alignment, deployment wave planning, site readiness, training, adoption, risks, and benefits tracking to ensure the program delivers measurable improvements in productivity, compliance, data quality, and manufacturing loss reduction.

**What’s in it For You:**

* Opportunity to lead deployment of a global manufacturing digital transformation agenda across Ecolab plants.
* Exposure to manufacturing excellence, Digital \& AI, TPM / HPN, operations, engineering, quality, safety, finance, and site leadership stakeholders.
* Ability to scale solutions that reduce manual work, improve shop\-floor productivity, strengthen compliance, and accelerate loss elimination.

**What You Will Do:**

* Lead end\-to\-end deployment of the Manufacturing Excellence Platform across pilot sites, scale\-up waves, and sustainment phases.
* Coordinate implementation of the manufacturing KPI control tower, including replacement of legacy KPI tools, single\-point KPI entry, standard KPI definitions, and integrated data flows.
* Develop and manage deployment plans covering site readiness, stakeholder engagement, training, change management, cutover, issue resolution, and adoption tracking.
* Partner with plant managers and manufacturing teams to validate current pain points, Wave\-1 KPI priorities, data requirements, paperless opportunities, and practical deployment constraints.
* Drive paperless factory deployment by assessing site activities, mapping manual touchpoints, identifying quick wins, and converting paper\-based processes into digital, touchless, and audit\-ready workflows.
* Support digital maturity assessments across sites using common process mapping, maturity scoring, prioritization matrices, effort\-benefit analysis, and deployment sequencing.
* Coordinate deployment of automation and digital solutions including EKODE, eQMS, ERP, Power Automate, Copilot Agent, OCR\-based tools, barcode / QR code scanning, machine vision, and AI\-enabled loss\-elimination use cases.
* Work with technology development resources, data engineers, developers, AI teams, and business stakeholders to translate program requirements into deployable solutions and practical rollout plans.
* Establish and maintain governance cadence, including weekly working sessions, monthly progress reviews, quarterly program reviews, stakeholder feedback forums, and steering committee updates.
* Track deployment milestones, adoption metrics, risks, issues, dependencies, resource needs, and decision points across all active workstreams.
* Partner with Finance and business teams to quantify and monetize KPI improvements, productivity gains, compliance risk reduction, and manufacturing loss\-elimination benefits.
* Prepare leadership\-ready status updates, deployment roadmaps, benefits trackers, risk / issue logs, action trackers, and decision materials for program reviews.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing Operations, Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or related field of study.
* 8\+ years of applicable experience in manufacturing, supply chain, operational excellence, digital transformation, project / program management, analytics, or technology\-enabled process improvement in a manufacturing environment with global or multi\-site operations.
* Demonstrated experience leading deployments, pilots, scale\-up waves, change management, training, adoption, and sustainment of business or digital solutions.
* Advanced proficiency with ERP, reporting, workflow, collaboration, and productivity tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Power Automate, Planner, and related enterprise systems.
* Proven ability to conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis, synthesize inputs from multiple stakeholders, and make practical recommendations to Manufacturing and Supply Chain leadership.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, teamwork, leadership, facilitation, and presentation skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Strong program management skills with a track record of delivering complex cross\-functional initiatives against schedule, quality, adoption, and business impact expectations.
* Experience with manufacturing excellence, TPM, HPN, Lean, Six Sigma, loss elimination, OEE / OPE / OLE, productivity, material loss, first\-pass quality, or related manufacturing KPIs.
* Experience deploying digital manufacturing tools, paperless workflows, automation, data visualization, AI use cases, or manufacturing control tower solutions.
* Familiarity with EKODE, eQMS, ERP, EBS, EPM, Power BI, workflow automation, OCR, barcode / QR code scanning, or machine vision technologies.
* PMP, Lean Six Sigma, APICS, or similar certification preferred.
* Advanced Degree preferred.

We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin,citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

title: Security Operation Manager
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

Your role
  

As a Security Operations Specialist, you will support the continuous protection of Kyndryl and customer environments by monitoring, detecting, and responding to security events. Your role will focus on day\-to\-day security operations, incident handling, and operational controls that reduce risk and improve resilience. Success is demonstrated through timely detection, clear incident documentation, and effective coordination with technical and business teams.

* Monitor security alerts and event data from security platforms to identify potential threats
* Investigate, triage, and respond to security incidents following defined runbooks and escalation paths
* Perform initial analysis to determine scope, impact, and urgency of incidents
* Execute containment actions such as isolating systems or blocking access under approved procedures
* Maintain accurate incident records, timelines, and evidence to support reporting and reviews
* Support vulnerability management activities, including validation and tracking of remediation actions
* Contribute to continuous improvement of security operations processes, playbooks, and controls
* Collaborate with internal teams and customers during incident response and post incident reviews

The career path ahead is full of exciting opportunities to grow and advance within the job family. With dedication and hard work, you can climb the ladder to higher bands, achieving coveted positions such as Principal Engineer or Vice President of Software. These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others


Required skills and experience


* Hands on experience in security operations, incident response, or a security operations center environment

* Experience analyzing security events, logs, and alerts to identify threats and false positives
* Understanding of common attack techniques, vulnerabilities, and threat categories
* Ability to follow documented procedures, escalation paths, and evidence handling requirements
* Experience documenting incidents, actions taken, and outcomes in a structured manner
Familiarity with basic networking, operating systems, and identity concepts  
* 

  

Preferred skills and experience


* Experience supporting customer environments in a managed services or service provider context
* Exposure to vulnerability management or threat intelligence workflows
* Experience participating in incident simulations, tabletop exercises, or post incident reviews
Relevant security certifications or formal security training  
* 

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The **Data \& ETL Engineering Lead (C13\)** is a senior technical leadership role responsible for architecting, designing, and delivering enterprise\-scale data integration, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data warehousing solutions. This role requires an expert data engineer with deep hands\-on proficiency in **Ab Initio**, modern **Python\-based data engineering**, and relational database engines (**Oracle DB**).


As a C13 Data Lead, you will oversee end\-to\-end data delivery across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), collaborate closely with cross\-functional business and technical stakeholders, define data architecture and modeling standards, and implement automated CI/CD deployment pipelines for high\-throughput batch and real\-time processing systems.


**Key Responsibilities**
========================


**1\. Technical Leadership \& Data Architecture**
-------------------------------------------------


* **ETL \& Pipeline Architecture:** Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of robust, high\-volume batch and real\-time ETL/ELT pipelines using **Ab Initio** and **Python**.
* **Data Warehousing Design:** Define and implement dimensional data models (Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Slowly Changing Dimensions \- SCD Type 1/2/3/4/6, Conformed Dimensions, Fact Tables) supporting large\-scale enterprise reporting and analytics.
* **Data Governance \& Quality:** Enforce enterprise data governance standards, data lineage, metadata management, data dictionary maintenance, and automated data validation/reconciliation frameworks.

**2\. Database Engineering \& Performance Optimization**
--------------------------------------------------------


* **Oracle Database Development:** Lead database design, complex SQL authoring, and advanced **PL/SQL** programming (Stored Procedures, Packages, Triggers, Table Functions).
* **Performance Tuning:** Perform comprehensive performance tuning of large\-scale ETL graphs, Python jobs, and Oracle queries via execution plans, indexing strategies, table partitioning, parallel execution, and optimizer hints.
* **Volume Management:** Architect solutions capable of processing multi\-terabyte datasets within stringent SLA time windows.

**3\. Stakeholder Management \& Collaboration**
-----------------------------------------------


* **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** Act as the primary technical liaison between business stakeholders, data product owners, quantitative analysts, reporting teams, and enterprise infrastructure partners.
* **Requirements Translation:** Translate complex business rules and regulatory requirements into detailed technical specifications, source\-to\-target mappings (STTM), and data flow architectures.
* **Agile \& Program Delivery:** Partner with Scrum Masters and Project Managers to plan sprint roadmaps, estimate technical effort, mitigate data pipeline risks, and manage dependency handoffs.

**4\. CI/CD \& DevOps Automation**
----------------------------------


* **DevOps for Data Pipelines:** Build and standardize automated **CI/CD pipelines** for packaging, testing, and deploying Ab Initio code/graphs, Python scripts, and Oracle DDL/DML migrations (e.g., using Jenkins, Harness, Tekton, GitLab CI, Liquibase).
* **Version Control \& Release Management:** Manage code repositories, branching workflows, and configuration management across environments (Dev, SIT, UAT, Prod).
* **Operational Monitoring \& Production Resilience:** Establish monitoring and alerting systems (e.g., Autosys, Control\-M, Grafana, Splunk, Loki), lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical batch failures, and drive operational stability.

**5\. Team Mentorship \& Engineering Standards**
------------------------------------------------


* **Team Leadership:** Mentor and guide mid\-level and junior ETL developers, data analysts, and database engineers.
* **Standardization:** Establish code review checklists, design patterns, reusable ETL modules/subgraphs, and automated unit/regression testing standards across data engineering teams.
  

  

**Technical Skills \& Competencies**
------------------------------------


**e**


**ETL \& Data Integration**


* Deep hands\-on expertise in **Ab Initio** (Co\>Operating System, GDE, Enterprise Meta\>Environment (EME), Continuous Flows, Plan\>It, Express\>It, Component Development, Subgraphs, Partitioning/De\-partitioning)
* Strong experience building custom data extractors, loaders, and transformers


**Python Data Engineering**


* Advanced **Python 3\.x** for data processing and pipeline scripting
* Proficiency with libraries such as **Pandas, NumPy, PyArrow, SQLAlchemy, PySpark, Polars**
* Writing clean, object\-oriented, testable Python code with unit test coverage (pytest/unittest)


**Data Warehousing \& Modeling**


* Comprehensive understanding of **Data Warehousing \& Data Lakehouse concepts** (Inmon vs. Kimball methodologies)
* Dimensional modeling (Star / Snowflake schemas, Factless Facts, Aggregate tables, SCD Types)
* Data lineage, Source\-to\-Target Mappings (STTM), metadata governance, and data profiling


**Database \& SQL**


* Advanced **Oracle 19c\+** \& **PL/SQL** programming (Complex joins, window functions, analytical functions, CTEs)
* Deep knowledge of Oracle optimizer, query execution plans, indexes (B\-tree, Bitmap), partitioning/sub\-partitioning strategies, and bulk operations (FORALL, BULK COLLECT)


**CI/CD \& Infrastructure**


* Experience in CI/CD pipeline authoring (**Jenkins, Harness, Tekton, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI**)
* Database change management tools (e.g., **Liquibase, Flyway**)
* Linux/Unix shell scripting (**Bash/Ksh**), job scheduling tools (**Autosys, Control\-M, Airflow**)
* Version control with **Git / Bitbucket**


**Testing \& Quality**


* Automated data testing, data reconciliation, boundary testing, and regression suites
* Code quality tools and security scanners (**SonarQube, Checkmarx, Snyk**)

  

  

**Experience \& Leadership Profile**
------------------------------------


* **Total Experience:** 10\+ years of professional experience in data engineering, data warehousing, and ETL development, with at least 3\+ years leading technical teams or complex data engineering initiatives.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Data Analytics, or equivalent quantitative discipline.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Prior experience in banking, financial services (e.g., Risk, Regulatory Reporting, Capital Markets, Retail Banking, Wealth Management), or large enterprise data systems is highly preferred.
* **Communication \& Influence:** Proven ability to communicate effectively with business stakeholders, summarize complex technical data architectures, and lead discussions with senior leadership.

Support ATM, POS, E\-Commerce, Card Management and payment switch integrations across domestic and international card transaction flows. • Provide L2 support for critical transaction processing across NPCI/RuPay, VISA, Mastercard, NFS, interchange and host system integrations. • Coordinate with L1 operations, infrastructure, network, database, security, application development, vendors and business/operations teams to ensure timely service restoration and long\-term stability. • Contribute to operational resilience through DR drills, failover/failback validation, preventive monitoring, automation and structured knowledge management.


Key Responsibilities


1\. Production Support and Service Operations • Provide Level\-2 production support for ATM Switch, Card Management Systems, DCMS/CCMS and related channel banking applications. • Monitor application health, transaction flows, switch queues, interface availability, host connectivity and network communication channels. • Analyse production issues using application logs, traces, dashboards, transaction data and database queries. • Ensure timely resolution of production incidents within agreed SLAs and operational risk controls. 2\. Incident Management, Temporary Fixes and Permanent Fixes • Take ownership of P1/P2 and business\-critical incidents from L2 perspective, including diagnosis, workaround, service restoration and stakeholder updates. • Implement approved temporary fixes to restore service quickly while ensuring operational risk is assessed and controlled. • Drive root cause analysis, corrective actions and permanent fixes to prevent recurrence. • Maintain clear incident timelines, technical observations, action owners, RCA inputs and closure evidence. 3\. ATM Switch Improvements and Bug Fix Management • Identify functional, technical and operational improvement opportunities in ATM Switch transaction processing, routing, authorisation, settlement and reconciliation flows. Internal document \| ATM Switch L2 Production Support JDThis is an Internal document. • Track application defects, recurring bugs and product issues with internal development teams and switch vendors until closure. • Participate in solution validation, SIT/UAT support, regression testing and production readiness checks for switch fixes and enhancements. • Ensure bug fixes are prioritised based on business impact, risk, incident recurrence and regulatory or audit relevance. 4\. Problem Management and Stability Improvement • Analyse recurring incidents, decline patterns, exception scenarios and operational trends to identify systemic issues. • Prepare preventive and corrective action plans to improve reliability, reduce repeat incidents and improve transaction success rates. • Work with technology teams and vendors to implement performance tuning, monitoring enhancements and reliability improvements. • Contribute to knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, runbooks and standard operating procedures. 5\. Change, Release and Deployment Support • Support production deployments, application patching, platform upgrades, switch configuration changes and release activities. • Perform impact analysis, implementation checks, rollback planning, sanity testing and post\-deployment validation. • Ensure changes are executed with minimal business disruption and aligned with change management governance. 6\. Vendor and Stakeholder Management • Coordinate with ATM Switch vendors, network partners, third\-party service providers and internal stakeholders for issue resolution and service improvement. • Follow up on vendor defects, RCAs, remediation plans, patch deliveries and product\-level fixes. • Communicate effectively during incidents, changes, releases, DR drills, audits and governance reviews.

title: Senior Staff Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**About Kaseya**



Kaseya is the leading provider of AI\-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long\-term business success.



Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double\-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.



Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders \- and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.



We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better \- a product, a process, a career \- you'll fit right in.



At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

 **Position Summary**



Kaseya is seeking a Senior Staff Software Engineer – DevTest / QA Automation to design, build, and maintain robust automated testing capabilities across enterprise software platforms.



This is a hands\-on software engineering role focused on test automation and engineering quality. The ideal candidate will have a strong programming background and be capable of building test libraries, automation frameworks, test infrastructure, and large scale automated test suites.



The role requires an engineer who can leverage AI assisted development tools and coding agents to accelerate automation, analyze existing codebases, generate and validate test scenarios, and rapidly expand automated coverage. The candidate should be comfortable working across application code, test infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments, and production troubleshooting.



The successful candidate will be able to take an existing codebase and, with limited direction, deliver hundreds of meaningful automated test cases within weeks, while maintaining quality, reliability, and maintainability.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks, test libraries, utilities, and reusable automation components.
* Build comprehensive automated test suites for enterprise SaaS applications, APIs, services, integrations, and distributed systems.
* Write production\-quality code to automate functional, integration, regression, API, and system\-level testing.
* Analyze existing application codebases and rapidly identify opportunities for automated test coverage.
* Develop and execute large\-scale automation initiatives capable of delivering hundreds of automated test cases in a short timeframe.
* Leverage AI coding assistants and AI agents extensively to accelerate test development, test generation, code analysis, debugging, and automation engineering.
* Validate AI\-generated code and test cases through appropriate engineering practices, including code review, execution, debugging, and test\-result analysis.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and test execution infrastructure.
* Work with CI/CD runners, build systems, deployment pipelines, test environments, and automation reporting.
* Develop automation that can run reliably in continuous integration and deployment environments.
* Troubleshoot automation failures, application issues, environment problems, and production defects using logs, metrics, traces, code, and system behavior.
* Participate in production troubleshooting and issue reproduction, including supporting incidents or reproducing customer issues outside standard working hours when required.
* Collaborate closely with software engineers, architects, product managers, DevOps, operations, and other QA/DevTest engineers to identify quality risks and improve engineering practices.
* Contribute to improvements in testability, observability, reliability, performance, and maintainability of the product.
* Identify gaps in existing test coverage and proactively create automation to prevent regression.
* Review application and test code and provide technical feedback on quality, maintainability, reliability, and automation effectiveness.
* Continuously improve automation speed, stability, coverage, and execution efficiency.


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12\+ years of software engineering, SDET, DevTest, or QA automation experience, with strong hands\-on programming experience.
* Programming skills in one or more languages such as Java, C\#, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar.
* Demonstrated experience building automation frameworks, test libraries, reusable testing components, and automation infrastructure.
* Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including object\-oriented programming, data structures, APIs, databases, debugging, and version control.
* Experience developing automated tests for APIs, backend services, web applications, distributed systems, or enterprise software.
* Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution, including familiarity with CI/CD runners and build/deployment infrastructure.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS or other cloud environments, with the ability to troubleshoot applications and test environments in the cloud.
* Experience troubleshooting complex application and production issues using logs, metrics, traces, database queries, and code level debugging.
* Ability to understand an existing codebase and independently build significant automated test coverage.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI assisted development tools/coding agents as part of day to day engineering and test automation work.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills with the ability to identify root causes rather than simply report failures.
* Strong understanding of test automation principles, test design, regression testing, and automation reliability.
* Ability to work collaboratively with engineering and cross functional teams.
* Willingness to support production issue reproduction and troubleshooting outside standard working hours when required.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience working on enterprise SaaS, IT management, cybersecurity, endpoint management, RMM, or other complex software platforms.
* Deep experience with AWS services and cloud\-hosted, data center hosted, or hybrid environments.
* Experience designing and maintaining large\-scale SDET/DevTest automation frameworks.
* Experience with API automation, integration testing, contract testing, service virtualization, or distributed\-system testing.
* Experience with tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, REST\-assured, pytest, JUnit, TestNG, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized test environments.
* Experience with CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases, including writing queries for test validation and production troubleshooting.
* Experience using AI coding agents to perform tasks such as code generation, test generation, codebase analysis, debugging, refactoring, and test optimization.
* Understanding of application security, scalability, reliability, observability, and distributed\-system behavior.
* Experience building automation capable of operating at significant scale without excessive flakiness or maintenance overhead.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive automation initiatives from design through implementation and production adoption.

**Additional information**  

*Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

title: Technical Lead (Databricks)
description:

At Bridgenext, we engineer Growth Operating Systems. Most enterprises have spent millions on their revenue stack and still aren't seeing the growth they expected.They have tools that function, but no system that wins. We help growth\-hungry companies close that gap by turning fragmented platforms, siloed teams, and disconnected data into one integrated Growth OS. As a Lead Data Engineer specializing in Databricks, you will be a key player in designing, developing, and optimizing our enterprise transportation client's next\-generation data platform. You will lead a team of data engineers, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and ensuring the scalable, and high\-performance data solutions.

* Technical Leadership:
* + Lead the design, development, and implementation of scalable and reliable data pipelines using Databricks, Spark, and other relevant technologies
	+ Define and enforce data engineering best practices, coding standards, and architectural patterns
	+ Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior and mid\-level data engineers
	+ Conduct code reviews and ensure the quality, performance, and maintainability of data solutions
* Databricks Expertise:
* + Architect and implement data solutions on the Databricks platform, including Databricks Lakehouse, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog
	+ Optimize Spark workloads for performance and cost efficiency on Databricks
	+ Develop and manage Databricks notebooks, jobs, and workflows
	+ Proficiently use Databricks features such as Delta Live Tables (DLT), Photon, and SQL Analytics
* Pipeline Development \& Operations:
* + Develop, test, and deploy robust ETL/ELT pipelines for data ingestion, transformation, and loading from various sources (e.g., relational databases, APIs, streaming data)
	+ Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging for data pipelines to ensure operational excellence
	+ Troubleshoot and resolve complex data\-related issues
* Collaboration \& Communication:
* + Work closely with cross\-functional teams including product managers, data scientists, and software engineers
	+ Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
	+ Stay updated with industry trends and emerging technologies in data engineering and Databricks

**Must Have Skills:**  

* Experience:
	+ 8\+ years of experience in data engineering, with at least 2\-3 years in a lead or senior capacity
	+ Proven experience designing and building large\-scale data platforms
* Primary Skills \- Databricks:
	+ Extensive hands\-on experience with Databricks platform, including Databricks Workspace, Spark on Databricks, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog
	+ Strong proficiency in optimizing Spark jobs and understanding Spark architecture
	+ Experience with Databricks features like Delta Live Tables (DLT), Photon, and Databricks SQL Analytics
* Programming:
	+ Expertise in Python (PySpark) is essential
	+ Strong proficiency in SQL
* Data Warehousing/Lakes:
	+ Deep understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and data lake architectures
	+ Experience with various data storage formats (Parquet, ORC, JSON, CSV)
* Cloud Platforms:
	+ Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and their data\-related services (e.g., S3, ADLS, GCS, EC2, Azure VMs, Google Compute Engine)
* Tools \& Technologies:
	+ Experience with version control systems (Git)
	+ Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for data solutions
	+ Knowledge of workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Apache Airflow, Databricks Workflows)
* Education:
	+ Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field

 **Preferred Skills:**  

* Experience with stream processing technologies (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis) is a plus
* Contributions to open\-source data projectsExperience with Scala or Java is a plus
* Databricks certifications (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate/Professional)
* Experience with MLOps and integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows

 **Professional Skills:**  

* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills
* Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast\-paced environment

description:
**Who we are**
--------------



VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.


As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.


\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

**About this role**
-------------------



We are seeking a Telecom Billing Operations Engineer to provide hands\-on L2 operational ownership of telecom billing platforms and billing\-cycle activities. This role is responsible for ensuring the successful execution of bill runs, invoice processing, call/CDR handling, reconciliation activities, and exception management while maintaining SLA and KPI commitments. The individual will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to resolve billing, rating, mediation and integration issues, contribute to automation and AI\-enabled operational improvements, and support governance, compliance and continual service improvement initiatives. This opportunity is ideal for professionals with 2 to 5 years of Telecom IT, BSS or enterprise billing application operations experience and strong production\-support expertise

**What you will do**
--------------------



Billing Operations \& Bill Run Processing  

* Own the day\-to\-day operational health and technical support of billing processes within the assigned service scope.
* Execute and monitor pre\-bill checks, bill preparation, bill production, bill generation, customer notifications and bill\-cycle closure activities.
* Diagnose and resolve bill\-run failures, rejected accounts, long\-running jobs, capacity constraints, database issues, scheduler failures and billing exceptions.
* Perform post\-bill validations, billed\-account reviews, amount reconciliations and exception tracking to support accurate and timely cycle closure.


Invoice Posting \& Downstream Processing  

* Monitor invoice generation, validation, posting, extraction and delivery to document management, printing and reporting platforms.
* Investigate invoice rejections, posting failures, missing outputs, balance mismatches and data\-quality issues, coordinating service restoration within agreed timelines.


Call / CDR Processing  

* Monitor daily call, event and CDR processing, including rating and re\-rating activities, suspended or rejected records, processing backlogs and delayed usage records.
* Troubleshoot file validation, processing\-chain, sequencing, capacity and data\-quality issues affecting throughput and performance.
* Support record recycling and reprocessing activities to maintain processing accuracy and service continuity.


Discrepancy Management \& Billing Assurance

description:

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  

As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2\) at NTT DATA, you'll take on a developing engineering role where your main goal is to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You'll achieve this by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. Your day will revolve around reviewing client requests and tickets, applying your technical expertise to resolve them efficiently and effectively. You'll be the go\-to person for second\-line support, handling incidents and requests of medium complexity. In addition to your daily tasks, you'll have opportunities to contribute to exciting project work from time to time.

title: Data Center Technician (DCO), Data Center Operations
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

Data Center Operations designs, installs \& maintains the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure. We are looking for skilled Data Centre Linux \& HW Engineer at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”) with a passion for technology to help us expand AWS Cloud offerings to the next level.  

  

ADSIPL offers an exciting, dynamic and challenging environment encouraging creativity and personal development while maintaining AWS computing environments in a secure, scalable, and cost\-effective manner.  

  

At ADSIPL, career progression is part of our environment. We want you to progress. If your career path is in Systems, Network or Database Engineering, Software Development or maybe AWS Support, Technical Operations or perhaps Project Management, we will create a development plan to enable you to succeed reaching those goals. This begins on Day One!  

  

Key job responsibilities  

A Data Centre Linux \& HW Engineer at ADSIPL may be the primary point of contact for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Database Engineers, Technical Operations) and external customers (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).  

  

Key job responsibilities  

A Data Centre Operation Technician at ADSIPL, expectation from role are:  

  

* You work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure.
* your role and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, server rack installation, hardware break\-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues also responding to emergent situations that affect operational stability.
* You may be the primary contact point for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Technical Operations) and external service partners (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).
* You will work and meet SLAs against assigned trouble tickets via a directed workflow, be the first line touch point for hardware troubleshooting and technical issues.
* You perform on\-call duties and will participate in Data Center operations, handling scheduled maintenance and change management activities that require monitoring of the data center infrastructure.
* You participate in team meetings for metric analysis and to discuss achieving daily/weekly goals.
* You possess knowledge of the policies and procedures, including safety and security, within your department, and understand the appropriate application of such knowledge
* You contribute to documentation on technical issues through root cause analysis for operational issues that occur, and contribute to process improvement initiatives relevant to the data center environment.
* More experienced technicians may assist in training less experienced members of the team.
* This role involves covering 24x7 shift rotation

  

A day in the life  

* You will support DC (Data Center) infrastructure equipment (e.g. racks, servers, networking devices, hardware components, cables, etc.),
* You will follow the instructions ticket\-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution and perform routine operation activities on hardware, or spare parts, including rack install, server break/fix, rack decom etc.
* You will perform on\-call duties and will participate in Data Center operations, handling scheduled maintenance and change management activities that require monitoring of the data center infrastructure.
* Show a strong aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving
* You will be involved with site management and maintain tidiness in operation areas
* Your role involves covering 24x7 shift rotation

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences
  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS
  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Work/Life Balance
  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  

  

Inclusive Team Culture
  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship and Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Knowledge of server hardware and components
* Knowledge of fiber optic and copper cabling standards, testing equipment and troubleshooting methodologies
* 2\+ years of data center experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working in a colocation data center facility
* Experience with computer hardware troubleshooting and repair
* Experience in networking

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. We're looking for a seasoned **Solution Architect** with HCL Commerce expertise to drive the design and evolution of a multi\-tier B2B commerce platform, steering architecture decisions across legacy Commerce systems, Spring Boot services, and modern Next.js storefronts.

**Responsibilities**

* Establish and maintain target and transitional architecture for multi\-tier B2B commerce, covering WCS store, business logic, Commerce tools, Spring Boot APIs, and Next.js / React storefront

* Assess designs and pull requests across Commerce, services, and storefront layers, tracking down complex cross\-layer defects to their root cause
* Provide guidance on capacity planning, caching strategies, search, and failure modes for a high\-traffic B2B storefront
* Coach senior engineers and leads, and document architecture decisions with context, options, and consequences to preserve continuity
* Spot key barriers and use structured problem\-solving methods for complex, multi\-system challenges

**Requirements**

* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 12\-20 years in professional software engineering, including at least 5 years as an architect or in an equivalent principal/staff design capacity on large\-scale commerce or comparably complex multi\-tier systems
* At least 8 years working with HCL Commerce and/or IBM WebSphere Commerce (WCS) 8\.x, spanning store customization, commands/tasks, tools, catalog/order/user/organization flows, and back\-end integration
* At least 8 years of experience in Java / J2EE and object\-oriented design on large IT systems, with a strong preference for WebSphere Application Server background
* At least 5 years working with Spring / Spring MVC, with hands\-on experience architecting Spring Boot solutions, including service boundaries, APIs, resilience, and authentication
* At least 5 years working with REST and SOAP web services, with the capability to define contracts for other teams to build against
* Hands\-on production architecture experience with Next.js and React, covering routing, data fetching, BFF/API integration, and storefront performance, with TypeScript knowledge preferred
* At least 5 years using source control systems, with required Git proficiency
* Preferred background in designing B2B commerce architecture, including punchout functionality, organizational/user models, and contract/pricing complexity
* Familiarity with Agile delivery methods using Atlassian tooling (Jira, Bitbucket/Git, Confluence)
* Strong written and verbal communication abilities suited to both technical and non\-technical audiences

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with headless/composable commerce concepts (API\-first storefronts, BFF, packaged capabilities) and MuleSoft or comparable iPaaS platforms
* Exposure to search technologies (Solr or similar), caching solutions (Redis or similar), and CMS\-driven storefronts (Optimizely or similar) working alongside a commerce engine
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (GKE/Kubernetes or similar) for storefront and Spring Boot deployment, plus WAS/IHS knowledge for Commerce
* Working knowledge of security practices, PCI\-adjacent payment flows, and session/identity management spanning legacy and modern storefronts
* Prior involvement in dual\-run setups or large\-scale commerce migration initiatives

title: Commissioning Project Engineer, Data Center Capacity Delivery Commissioning APJC
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. AWS Infrastructure is responsible for the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help. You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles to power the world's largest cloud computing infrastructure.  

  

This role offers a structured development path within the Commissioning organization:  

* Comprehensive onboarding and training on AWS commissioning processes and management systems
* Mentorship from DCCD Cx team members
* Exposure to diverse project types across AWS's global data center portfolio including mechanical, electrical, and controls systems
* Clear progression pathway: advance to Business Analyst / Program Coordinator (program management track) or Commissioning Engineer (technical track)

  

In this role, you will provide project management support to the commissioning engineers. You will provide support on both administrative and process tasks including vendor onboarding and procurement coordination and commissioning workflow management. You will be given opportunities to work alongside experienced commissioning professionals and will analyze commissioning workflow data to identify bottlenecks, recommend process improvements to enable smooth execution of data center construction projects across AWS’s infrastructure. The ideal candidate will be detail\-oriented, take ownership of their work, demonstrate passion for process improvement and show eagerness to learn and be curious in a fast\-paced environment.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

The key responsibility of a Project Engineer is to develop a detailed understanding of AWS critical infrastructure. You will learn the fundamentals related to managing a commissioning project within AWS. As part of this process you will work with different team members who will introduce you to the internal project management tools. You will then progress to the on the job phase where you will participate in the on\-site commissioning activities. During the phase of you will support the Lead Commissioning Engineers with managing a project from beginning to end.  

  

* Manage the creation of projects within internal Amazon systems.
* Manage the financial and vendor management related task of the commissioning process.
* Support the Request for Quote process, ensuring all relevant documentation is available for the commissioning vendors to provide a detailed quote.
* Provide administrative support to commissioning engineers in managing commissioning workflows and processes
* Organize and maintain commissioning documentation
* Gather feedback from commissioning engineers and stakeholders to improve workflows and processes by identifying and implementing workflows improvements

  

About the team  

Join the commissioning team, a critical function within AWS Data Center Capacity Delivery that ensures technical excellence and operational readiness across our global data center construction portfolio. Our team provides oversight and coordination of multi\-discipline commissioning activities related to pre\-commissioning, startup, and acceptance testing of Amazon critical infrastructure construction projects.  

  

As part of the Data Center Commissioning Team, you will be part of a highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of AWS owned data centers within the APJC region and globally. The AWS Data Center Capacity Delivery Commissioning team (DCCD Cx) understands, evaluates, defines, and manages the expectations of construction and equipment quality in accordance with engineering designs to meet customer requirements and ensure systems perform as designed.  

  

This role offers a unique opportunity to develop expertise in data center commissioning and startup coordination within one of the world's most innovative technology companies. You'll receive mentorship from industry\-leading commissioning professionals, gain exposure to technology leading critical infrastructure systems, and contribute to projects that shape the future of cloud computing infrastructure.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or Master's degree or above in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio, and MS Project) at an advanced level
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of mechanical and electrical systems
* Experience in designing experiments and statistical analysis of results

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Technical Support Professional
description:
TomTom's services run around the clock — and the NOC is the team keeping watch. We monitor every service, spot trouble before customers feel it, drive incidents to resolution and keep everyone informed while we do it.  

We're now inviting aspiring team members who want to expand their skills and experience to apply for a lateral opportunity within NOC Operations.  

  

This is a career progression move into the NOC team. You'll get hands\-on exposure to NOC responsibilities, incident management, service operations and technical problem handling. It's designed for people who want to build real expertise and pursue a longer\-term career path in NOC Operations. Following a successful selection process, you'll go through the onboarding and training needed to support your transition into the role.
### **What you'll do**

* Monitor, troubleshoot, document, escalate and continuously improve IT infrastructure and NOC operations to ensure reliable service delivery and rapid incident resolution.
* Monitor TomTom's production services and infrastructure around the clock — working across tools like PagerDuty, Grafana and AlertSite to catch degradations before customers feel them.
* Triage and troubleshoot alerts and incidents as they arrive — establishing impact, forming a first hypothesis and taking the tactical steps that restore service fastest.
* Escalate to the right engineering teams at the right moment — with enough context that they can act immediately, and stay with the incident until it's resolved.
* Own incident communication end to end — keeping engineers, Leadership and Internal/External stakeholders informed while the incident is still unfolding.
* Document what you handle — incident timelines, runbooks and knowledge articles that make the next shift faster than the last.
* Continuously improve NOC operations — tuning noisy alerts, sharpening processes and using automation and AI tools to cut manual effort in reporting, event and knowledge management.

### **What you'll need**


NOC is looking for strong analytical thinkers who enjoy solving problems and thrive in a high\-pressure environment with shifting priorities. You should be able to assess a situation and determine tactical steps forward.  

Core skills (0–2 years)  

  

* A basic understanding of applications, systems and monitoring tools — exposure to PagerDuty, Grafana or AlertSite is a plus, though curiosity matters more to us than the length of your tool list.
* Familiarity with ticketing tools such as ServiceNow or Jira — where you'll log incidents, track progress and leave a clean handover for the next shift; training will be provided.
* Good time management and organizational skills — with the ability to triage a new alert, chase an engineering update and prepare a handover within the same hour.
* Basic knowledge of incident management processes — how incidents are detected, prioritized, escalated and closed, and why restoring service quickly and finding the underlying cause are two different jobs.
* Excellent spoken and written communication skills — explaining a technical situation clearly and concisely to engineers, leadership and customers, often while it's still unfolding.
* The ability to work in rotational shifts (24x7\) — including nights, weekends and public holidays, on a rotation the team makes work together.
* A highly motivated, self\-starting approach — digging into something unfamiliar, asking good questions and coming back with an answer rather than waiting to be told.
* A team\-player mentality and a customer\-focused mindset — every alert traces back to someone depending on a TomTom service, and keeping that in view shapes how you prioritize and communicate.
* Basic awareness of AI tools and automation — and how they can strengthen event, incident and knowledge management, improve reporting and streamline ServiceNow processes and tooling.
### **Nice to have**

* Previous internship or hands\-on experience in IT support or a helpdesk environment.
* Exposure to automation concepts for reporting or incident handling. (edited)

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. description:
**Description**

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team \- we’d love to have you apply!  

  

**About the role:**  

Ampere is hiring a senior individual contributor to build the engineering foundation for enterprise AI. The role covers platform services, knowledge and retrieval systems, MCP integrations, and agent workflows.


This is a hands\-on engineering role. You will make design decisions, write production code, establish technical standards, and remain accountable for the systems after release. You will work with engineering, data, IT, security, and business teams to deliver AI capabilities that are secure, reliable, and useful.

 **What you’ll achieve:**  

* Build and operate shared services, APIs, automations, and integrations that allow teams to use approved AI models, enterprise data, and business tools.
* Improve reliability, performance, deployment, monitoring, logging, incident response, and operating documentation.
* Set implementation standards and build common components that reduce duplicated work across AI initiatives.
* Develop embedding, indexing, and retrieval methods for technical and enterprise knowledge.
* Improve search quality through hybrid retrieval, metadata filtering, access\-aware retrieval, reranking, query processing, source citations, and evaluation.
* Apply appropriate data structures and algorithms to search, ranking, caching, state management, and performance.
* Build test sets and measurement methods for retrieval accuracy, grounding, latency, cost, and failure handling.
* Design and implement MCP clients, servers, and tool integrations for enterprise systems.
* Define tool interfaces, schemas, authentication, authorization, approval flows, audit records, and lifecycle practices.
* Build and maintain integrations with engineering, knowledge, ticketing, source\-control, data, and business systems.
* Maintain a managed tool catalog with ownership, access controls, versioning, test coverage, monitoring, and retirement practices.
* Build agent workflows that plan tasks, call tools, retain execution state, request approval when needed, and recover from failure.
* Implement scheduling, retries, checkpoints, cancellation, escalation, and human review for long\-running work.
* Set controls for agent permissions, credential scope, tool risk, evidence capture, and auditability.
* Measure task completion, tool outcomes, workflow quality, latency, reliability, and cost.
* Apply enterprise identity and security requirements across AI services, including OAuth2/OIDC, SSO, managed identities, RBAC, secrets management, and least\-privilege access.
* Address prompt injection, data leakage, unsafe tool access, excessive permissions, and poor source provenance.
* Work with security and platform teams to maintain the controls, monitoring, and operating practices required for enterprise AI

 **About you:**  

* M.Tech in Computer Engineering or related field with 3\+ years of experience or B.Tech in Computer Engineering or releated field with 5\+ years of experience
* 3\+ years of experience building production software, platform services, developer tools, data systems, or applied AI products.
* Strong software\-engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, API design, schema design, asynchronous systems, testing, debugging, and performance analysis.
* Strong programming skills in Python and TypeScript, plus experience building and maintaining React applications.
* Experience building APIs, integrations, background jobs, automations, and services that use enterprise authentication and authorization.
* Experience with LLM applications, tool calling, structured outputs, semantic search, retrieval systems, or agent workflows.
* Experience with embeddings, hybrid search, metadata design, ranking, access\-aware retrieval, retrieval evaluation, and vector or search infrastructure.
* Experience with MCP or comparable tool\-integration protocols, including tool contracts, schemas, authentication, authorization, and lifecycle management.
* Experience designing reliable workflows with state management, retries, idempotency, checkpoints, cancellation, and audit trails.
* Working knowledge of Linux, Git, Docker, CI/CD, cloud deployment, monitoring, logging, and production incident response.
* Sound security judgment across identity, access control, secrets, sensitive data, and AI\-specific threats

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Rust and Tauri experience, or experience building native desktop applications.
* Azure experience, including Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Key Vault, Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, and Azure VMs.
* Experience with search and vector platforms such as Azure AI Search, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Qdrant, Weaviate, Pinecone, or Chroma.
* Experience with workflow orchestration, event\-driven systems, queues, schedulers, state machines, or durable execution platforms.
* Infrastructure\-as\-code experience with Terraform, Bicep, or similar tools.
* Experience with Redis, caching, rate limiting, telemetry, usage analytics, capacity planning, or cost management.
* Experience with pytest, Vitest, Playwright, contract testing, integration testing, or AI evaluation frameworks.
* Experience in semiconductor, advanced computing, developer platform, or enterprise engineering environments.

 **What we’ll offer:**  

  

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long\-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits.  

  

Benefits highlights include:* Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work.
* Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work\-life balance
* Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day.

  

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process.  

  

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real\-time cross\-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.



Co\-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11\-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.



It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.



Our payout network spans 190\+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 \+ corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40\+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross\-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross\-Border Payments Companies list.



In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1\.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high\-growth company.

 **The Role**

At Nium, we’re revolutionising the global payments industry — and data sits at the core of everything we do. We’re looking for a **passionate and skilled Data Engineer** to join our India\-based Data Engineering team.

This is more than a purely technical role. You’ll help shape the future of our data platform as we migrate from on\-premises systems to **AWS cloud**. You’ll work hands\-on with modern tools such as **Airflow, Redshift, dbt**, and **Kafka**, collaborating closely with product, engineering, analytics, and business teams to deliver high\-quality, scalable data solutions that power real\-world payments and enable data\-driven decision\-making.

You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to high\-impact projects, solve complex technical problems, and work on a platform that supports millions of users globally. If you’re motivated by learning, collaboration, and building resilient data platforms at scale, this role offers a strong opportunity for growth.
### **Key Responsibilities**

* Build and optimise **scalable**, **maintainable**, and **high\-performance data pipelines** and workflows.
* Ingest, transform, and deliver high\-volume data from a range of structured and unstructured sources, including **MySQL** databases and **real\-time Kafka** streams.
* Design and maintain performant data models in Redshift, and optimise SQL queries to support analytics and reporting workloads.
* Contribute to our **cloud migration journey** and help evolve the data architecture with new ideas and improvements.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional, globally distributed teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Embed **data quality, reliability, observability,** and **security** as first\-class principles across the data platform.
* Support and enhance data solutions operating in a mission\-critical payments environment.
* Continuously learn, share knowledge, and help raise standards across data governance, quality, and security practices.
### **Requirements**

* **2–3 years of professional experience** in Data Engineering or a related role.
* **Strong SQL expertise**, including query optimisation, complex transformations, and **datamodelling**.
* Solid **Python** skills for data engineering and pipeline development.
* Hands\-on experience with **AWS services** such as Redshift, Lambda, Glue, and S3, as well as Airflow for orchestration.
* Familiarity with modern transformation and modelling practices using tools such as dbt.
* A collaborative mindset, strong problem\-solving skills, critical thinking, and a willingness to take ownership and initiative.

**Nice to Have**
* Experience contributing to **large\-scale cloud migration** initiatives.
* Knowledge of **real\-time data streaming** using Kafka.
* Exposure to **CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure\-as\-code** for data platforms.
* Interest in exploring AI/ML use cases within modern data ecosystems.
* Understanding of the payments domain or fintech data challenges.
**What we offer at Nium**

**We Value Performance:** Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.

**We Care for Our Employees:** The wellness of Nium’ers is our \#1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our year\-end shut down. We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).

**We Upskill Ourselves:** We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role\-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend.

**We Celebrate Together:** We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company\-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more!

**We Thrive with Diversity:** Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18\+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.  


**Beware of recruitment scams:** Be cautious of individuals impersonating Nium via WhatsApp, social media, email or unofficial websites. **Do not respond, share personal or financial information, or make any payments**. Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**Who we are**

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
